description: Create a defined name for a cell, or repoint an existing one, so set_inputs and get_outputs can use a readable key ("Revenue") instead of a cell ref. A name that already exists in the same scope is overwritten with the new target; no cell's value or formula changes. Names follow Excel's rules (start with a letter, _ or \, no spaces, not a cell ref) and invalid ones fail the call. Returns {name, refers_to, defined_names}, the last being every name after the change. To remove a name use delete_variable; to see the existing names first, use inspect_model.

name.description: Name to create or repoint, following Excel's name rules (e.g. "Revenue", "Exit_Cap")

refers_to.description: Cell reference the name points to (e.g. "Sheet1!$A$1")

scope_sheet.description: 0-based sheet index for a sheet-scoped name; omit for workbook scope

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: define_variable
title: Define variable
